title: Rolling primer, descent kept small
coachNotes: Day 1 of the swapped weekend, and its only job is to not compromise Sunday. Aerobic volume yes, eccentric load no: descent trimmed from 700m to ~450m and nothing long or steep. If you find yourself on a big descent you have picked the wrong route. Ceiling 151, and if HRV is under 55 Saturday morning cut this to 90 minutes rather than touching Sunday.
